status: PUBLISHED; fix round after REVIEW_E_OF_B; aligned with A.3, C.3, D.3, E.3

consumes.A: A.3: evaluate stdin attempt {index, parent_status_sha256, fencing_token, parent: ledger record of the previous physical attempt {fit_id, attempt_index, fencing_token, state, state_sha256}}; no resume_checkpoint (RESUME_UNSUPPORTED)
consumes.C: C.3: views + pinned weekly plan (v4 at the time of writing, read by digest, never hardcoded); AnnualAccumulator keyed by arm (arm_sha256 = finalist genotype, arm_role); tools.i6n_weekly_multi_output resolve_arms on the pinned i6n.multi_output_arms.v1 template
consumes.D: D.3: ArchivePublisher.record_candidate(candidate without won, fold_receipts) and record_decision(i6n.archive.decision.v1, increasing sequence) when a horizon search closes; node ingests the reference spool (doin-node archive_reference_spool)
consumes.E: E.3: sealed plan JSON pinned by path+sha (never hardcoded); fold ids resolved onto plan quarters; ranking only via tools.i6n_search_plan.score_folds(plan, receipts, supports, genotype_canonical_sha256=, horizon_hours=, origins_sha256=C digests); legacy mapping fold_score_reuse NONE adopts nothing

identities.fit_id: sha256(canonical {experiment, fold, effective_config_sha256, context_sha256, support_sha256}); one physical fit unit; plan independent so verified terminals are reused across plans/nodes/directories
identities.fencing_token: globally monotonic integer issued by the ledger per claim; passed to A as attempt.fencing_token (string)

ledger.storage: <campaign-root>/state/ledger.sqlite3 (WAL), single authority on the coordinator; workers reach it through tools.i6n_swarm.lease_service (HTTP JSON, bearer token from a private file)
ledger.claim: claim(fit_id, owner, host, boot_id, device_class, ttl_seconds) -> {result: CLAIMED|ADOPT|HELD|WAIT_RESOURCE|REFUSED, token, attempt:{index, kind: INITIAL|RESUME|RECOVERY, parent_attempt, parent_status_sha256}, terminal, cause}
ledger.renew: renew(fit_id, token, progress) -> bool; false means the holder must self-fence (kill its child) before the lease expires
ledger.complete: outer keys AND inner candidate_receipt (genotype, fold, horizon, experiment, effective config, seed) AND shared_receipt support (digest, counts) must belong to the unit, else ReceiptMismatch
ledger.recover: recover(host, boot_id) at boot: RUNNING attempts of a previous boot or with an expired lease -> INTERRUPTED
ledger.policy: max 3 physical attempts per fit_id; ONE linked RECOVERY attempt (no RESUME while the evaluator lacks optimizer/RNG checkpoints); the claim returns attempt.parent for index>1; OOM/timeout/evaluator refusal are terminal FAILED
ledger.prior: register_prior(fit_id, receipt, source): adopted at the first claim of exactly that fit_id after identity verification; never refit
ledger.search_state: put_search_state(dag_node, generation, state) immutable per generation (wrapper writes after create/reproduce)

evaluation.doin_wrapper: doin_plugins.predictor.optimizer.PredictorOptimizer with optimization_config.i6n_swarm (shared-only, no predictor/preprocessor/target imports, no default_optimizer fallback)
evaluation.evaluator_callable: tools.i6n_swarm.bridge:evaluate (runs in the node executor thread; launches one crispdm-run admitted subprocess per fold; no SIGALRM, no CPU fallback)
evaluation.node_environment: I6N_SWARM_NODE_CONFIG=<private node json> (ledger url/token file, owner, host key, boot id source, device, crispdm-run path, caps)
evaluation.fold_aggregation: only tools.i6n_search_plan.score_folds; production refuses any other aggregator, partial origins and any origins_binding other than VERIFIED; the reference scorer exists for fixtures and is never returned by resolve_score_folds
evaluation.result_binding: result.candidate_identity == wire.identity and result.hyper_dict == effective_config(wire.genome); the node refuses a peer result whose candidate_identity differs from its population entry
evaluation.orphan_guard: tools/i6n_swarm/childguard.py sits between the supervisor and crispdm-run; when the DOIN node process disappears it TERMs the launcher (scope stop + reservation release), so no fit outlives its lease holder
evaluation.doin_config: optimization_config carries i6n_plan (sealed E plan), i6n_horizon, i6n_admitted_classes, i6n_folds {fold: {i6n_support, i6n_evaluation_context, i6n_origins_sha256}} so E's v2 path runs; i6n_swarm.context is the plan-bound swarm context; the plan seed is passed unchanged to reproduction
evaluation.class_admission: a size class without an admitted pilot cap is a typed WAIT_RESOURCE CLASS_NOT_ADMITTED before any claim

stages: freeze_folds:h / freeze_weeks:h (A freeze, data only, CPU)
annual:h (finalists x READY weeks, weekly refit)

multi_output:short|long: lane C template resolved from inner-fold finalists; only READY arms; WAIT_DEPENDENCY EVALUATOR_LACKS_DIRECT_MULTI_OUTPUT_ARM until A/E provide an adapted config (capability DIRECT_MULTI_OUTPUT_ARM)
dag.activation: coordinator tick (systemd timer) activates successors; a localized failure blocks only its dependants

publication: collect: candidates without won; typed FAILED SCORE_REFUSED:<code> with no fitness; genotype {active, inactive} and lineage from the persisted v2 search state; record_decision per closed search
pins: binding pins may be {relpath, sha256} relative to each host's shared_data_root (freeze outputs are recorded that way); A's contexts themselves still carry absolute paths
